# DeckHelm

> DeckHelm is a free deck building code calculator. It sizes joists, beams, footings, posts and stairs to the IRC R507 deck code, using the real span tables, your state's frost depth, and produces a permit-ready breakdown.

## Main pages

- [Home and calculator](https://www.deckhelm.com/): the free deck calculator
- [Calculators](https://www.deckhelm.com/calculators): all deck calculators
- [Find a deck builder](https://www.deckhelm.com/find-a-deck-builder): finding a local deck builder
- [Pricing](https://www.deckhelm.com/pricing): plans and pricing
- [Methodology](https://www.deckhelm.com/methodology): how the calculations are derived

## Guides

- [Blog](https://www.deckhelm.com/blog): deck construction and permit guides
- [State frost depth and permit notes](https://www.deckhelm.com/states): state-level reference pages
